settings.label: Autohide
settings.description: Appears at the chosen screen edge. Free position stays visible so its drag handle remains reachable.

settings.label: Position
settings.description: Choose a screen edge, or drag the handle in Free position. Edge docks join the frame when enabled.

settings.label: Horizontal position
settings.description: Position within the available screen area (0–1).

settings.label: Vertical position
settings.description: Position within the available screen area (0–1).

settings.label: Smart
settings.description: Visible when no window covers the dock

settings.label: Pinned apps
settings.description: Desktop ids in order. Pin and move them most easily by right-clicking in the dock.

settings.label: Launcher button
settings.description: Add the app launcher to the dock.

settings.label: Launcher position
settings.description: 0 = first. Higher values move the launcher along the dock.

settings.label: Window previews
settings.description: Show live window previews when hovering over running apps.

settings.label: Icon order
settings.description: Saved by dragging icons in the dock. Running apps keep their position without being pinned.

settings.label: Extra dock space
settings.description: Make the dock larger without resizing app icons.

settings.label: Trash button
settings.description: Open the trash from the dock.

settings.label: Overview button
settings.description: Show a button for the window overview in the dock.

settings.label: Hover magnification
settings.description: 1 = no magnification. Applies to app icons and dock buttons.

settings.label: Hover lift
settings.description: Move hovered icons toward the desktop. 0 = no lift.

settings.label: Show app names on hover
settings.description: Shows a label when no window preview is enabled for the icon.

settings.label: Hover preview delay
settings.description: Wait before showing a window preview or app name.
